nodes.title: How to use / reuse this
widgets_values:
### Mathematador screen-art generator

Generates a full portrait (default 768x1344) background: a fixed hand-drawn crop of the boy + Toro Numerico in the middle, with the arena scenery extended above/below by the model so there's no flat color gap.

**To generate a new screen:**
1. Prepare your character crop separately (outside this graph) — a real frame from `intro.mp4` cropped to ~768px wide, containing the pose you want, **no padding added**. Static side-by-side poses fuse the boy and bull into one creature on this checkpoint — always use a dynamic pose (running/jumping/gesturing).
2. Put that crop in ComfyUI's `input/` folder, select it in the **LoadImage** node.
3. Set **ImagePadForOutpaint**'s `top`/`bottom` (and `left`/`right` if needed) so the final canvas is your target size (currently 768 wide, top+height+bottom should total 1344 for portrait). `feathering` 80 is the minimum that avoids a visible seam — don't go lower.
4. Edit the **positive prompt** to describe ONLY the new extended area, split into an "above" clause and a "below" clause — a single blended description bleeds between the two regions (e.g. roof tiles appearing at the bottom).
5. Leave **denoise at 1.0** — the mask (not denoise) is what protects the character region; this is correct, not a bug.
6. If Toro Numérico's glowing numbers need to survive in your source crop, they were being erased by any full-image img2img above denoise ~0.4 in earlier attempts (not used in this graph, which never touches the character region at all) — not a concern here since the character area is fully protected, but keep it in mind if you build a different graph for posing the characters themselves before this one.

See `mathematador-app/assets/working/comfy-workflows/README.md` in the repo for the full history of what was tried and why.
